There are no integrate: commits. Both branches start at 0bade52, which was the integration HEAD, and they touch disjoint files: ui-fit changes src/ui/* and two tests, aisle-pace changes src/data/waves.ts and two docs. tsc and vitest passed after each merge, so no seam needed a fix.
integrate3.goldenGate: Exit 0. The before snapshots in scratchpad/gg/before3 were copied before the first merge. The gate compared them with tests/golden/__snapshots__ at HEAD and printed "changed leaves: 0, undeclared: 0" for build.json and text.json. Vitest ran without -u and git status stayed clean, so the goldens were not rewritten. The results file was written first, at scratchpad/w4-results.json: 2 units, each with goldenPrefixes [].
integrate3.tsc: npx tsc --noEmit had exit 0 with "No errors found" after the ui-fit merge, after the aisle-pace merge, and in the final gate.
integrate3.vitest: npx vitest run gave "Test Files 198 passed (198), Tests 2360 passed (2360)" in all three full runs: after the ui-fit merge, after the aisle-pace merge, and in the final gate. The count fits the units: the base had 197 files and 2355 tests, ui-fit adds 1 file and 5 tests, and aisle-pace adds none.
integrate3.build: npm run build had exit 0 and printed "built in 3.07s". Vite warned that one chunk is larger than 1600 kB (dist/assets/index-CeHrzmxe.js, 1,765.03 kB, 521.93 kB gzip). That is a warning, not a failure. I did not check whether the base shows the same warning.
open: ui-fit's single unexplained test failure (1 failed, 2359 passed, in one run on its own branch) did not come back in the 3 full suite runs on integration. The failing test is still unidentified.
aisle-pace's bot and build-lab numbers were measured on its own branch, not on the merged head. ui-fit only touches UI files, so I expect the numbers still hold, but that is inferred, not measured.
The merge commit titles are my own wording. scratchpad/specs/ has no spec for ui-fit or aisle-pace, so there was no canonical title to copy.

Each unit's own open items are listed in full in scratchpad/w4-results.json. ui-fit has 5: no keyboard or gamepad scroll on the end receipt, an extreme shop overflow, the z-index of #tutorial over overlays, the first-shop bubble covering the service buttons, and the crate star chip overlapping the kind label. aisle-pace has 6: aisle 3 reach of 60% against 69%, the noisy 3-run predicate, the aisle 4 death share of 27.7% on seed 2, stale pooled numbers in the 5649650 commit body, tools/botrun.mjs hanging on the loot and stockroom picks, and Evening on seed 1 at 18.0%.
